draft_subject: Architecture and interactive-design referrals for a revocable library mandate
draft_body:
Dear Iceland Design and Architecture team,

Your selection of Samfélag í bleyti brings architecture and interactive exhibition design together around shared civic life (https://www.honnunarmidstod.is/ha-frettir/samfelag-i-bleyti-er-framlag-islands-a-feneyjatviaeringi). I’m looking for a related research conversation in Iceland.

I’m developing Proxy Society, an architecture research project on AI agents and robots acting for absent people under limited, revocable mandates. A proposed library pilot would compare a staffed booking desk, ordinary online booking and a staged AI proxy bay. A revocable task token would make the person’s permission inspectable, while preserving personal arrival and time spent in the building. Evaluation would include encounters and staff work.

Could you suggest one named architect and one interaction researcher who could jointly critique the layout and permission prototype? I would separately verify their academic roles and any doctoral route.

Best regards,
Kris Haamer
Proxy Society
https://proxysociety.org/architecture

draft_subject: Public-building member referral: shared waiting and delegated booking
draft_body:
Dear Architects Association of Iceland team,

Your statement on public-building quality emphasizes how architecture connects people and neighborhoods (https://www.honnunarmidstod.is/ha-frettir/vondu%C3%B0-honnun-er-abyrg-uppbygging). I want to keep that effect visible when evaluating delegated access.

I’m developing Proxy Society, an architecture research project on AI agents and robots acting for absent people under limited, revocable mandates. At a civic room’s entrance, I would compare a common waiting bench with a separate proxy bay. An AI representative would request one booking under a mandate that expires or can be withdrawn. Plans and staged observation would test accessibility, encounters and human handoff, retaining a person’s own attendance.

Could you recommend a member with relevant civic-building experience who could critique this pilot, and advise how to approach an operator for an initial research discussion? No site access is assumed.

Best regards,
Kris Haamer
Proxy Society
https://proxysociety.org/architecture
